description: site/data/catalogs.js -- owned by kit, vendored everywhere, never hand-edited by a list repo. The file assigns three separate globals, not one object, so this file's root is unused (just a $defs container) -- each global's own `// schema: catalogs.schema.json#/$defs/<Name>` directive in catalogs.js points at its own def below.

LanguageNames.description: window.LANGUAGE_NAMES -- language code -> plain display name. Keys are what a series entry's languages[].value references (plus the literal '…?' sentinel for "Unknown additional languages").

RatingKinds.description: window.RATING_KINDS -- rating-source kind -> label info. Keys are referenced by rating.scores[].kind (score-link mode, reads only `.label`) or a top-level rating.kind (badge mode, reads `.abbrTerm`/`.abbrDef`/`.textOnly`). `steam` is handled by special-case code and is deliberately not a key here.

SteamReviewLabels.description: window.STEAM_REVIEW_LABELS -- Steam review abbreviation -> full adjective. Keys are the only values a rating.scores[].score can hold when that score's kind is 'steam'.
